rules: Use the same canonical 2024-26 possession and terminal-lineup rows for every model.
Define possession progress from the count before the possession and fixed 25-possession buckets. Top-code the eighth bucket at 176 plus. Do not divide by final game possessions.
Estimate both score curves from out-of-fold lineup residuals.
Subtract only the signed-margin slope term from the RAPM target, not the bucket intercept.
Fit score curves on 2024-25 and use 2026 only as reused diagnostics.
For the primary comparison, score adjusted player coefficients without the score-context term.
For the secondary comparison, add the observed pre-possession context term back and label the result conditional.
